description: P1 Ryu beats Retsu with 5,320 pts, P2 Ken joins during Geki and beats Ryu 2-0, P1 leaves controls neutral until the 30-second name-entry timer expires, and F50 inserts rank 9 and returns Ken to Stage 1 intro.

reference.notes: US set 1, six-button controls; MAME set sf. ROM set verified by mame -verifyroms against the pinned build.
